discounts.title: Discount rules
discounts.subtitle: Automatic discounts and coupons, applied at checkout
discounts.name: Rule name
discounts.priorityHint: Rules run from the lowest number to the highest.
discounts.stackableHint: Off: once this rule discounts a line, lower-priority rules skip it.
discounts.scheduleHint: Leave empty to run all the time.
discounts.conditionsHint: The rule applies to a line when the conditions match. Leave empty to apply to every line.
discounts.expressionHint: Optional. Must also be true for the rule to apply. Example: customer.orders_count >= 10 and customer_spent(90) > 500
discounts.expressionFacts: Available: customer, item, cart, context (e.g. customer.orders_count, item.category_id) and customer_orders(days), customer_spent(days), item_bought(days), item_orders(days), category_bought(days), min(), max().
discounts.couponHint: If set, the rule only applies when the cashier enters this code.
discounts.simulatorSubtitle: See which rules would apply, without selling anything
